description: Keep the creators that appear in both lists, in the order of the left list. Nothing is stored. A search_creators result maps to the saved creator shape: profileId is the creator id, and fitScore, followerCount, name, platform, profileImageUrl, and username carry over. Needs a credential.

left.description: First creator list; the result keeps this order

fitScore.description: Fit score from search_creators, 0 to 1, or null when unknown

followerCount.description: Follower count at snapshot time, at least 1000

platform.description: ig for Instagram or tt for TikTok

profileImageUrl.description: Portrait URL from search_creators, or null

username.description: Creator handle from search_creators, or null
